body.statement: Under independent multinomial sampling, for every \(n\ge1\), \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal M_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}}P^n\{\mathcal I_{k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)\subseteq\mathcal C_{n,k_0}^{\tau}\}\ge1-\alpha\). The event covers both marginal identified sets simultaneously. No endpoint-consistency, Hausdorff-consistency, or branch-persistence conclusion is asserted.
body.justification: Finite-sample full-PMF inversion provides honest coverage of every disconnected component without choosing a latent branch.
body.gap: Romano--Shaikh develops general inference for identified sets under stated pointwise and uniform conditions; this auxiliary result uses finite multinomial concentration to cover the entire completed-stratum image and deliberately makes no topology-consistency claim.
body.consumer: Applied analyses can attach a finite-sample honest region to the exact singular identified set while clearly separating coverage from set estimation.
